title: GENESIS 2.5: optimisation and opt-in OpenCL/CUDA acceleration for the GENESIS/PGENESIS compartmental neural simulator
description: GENESIS 2.4 / PGENESIS 2.4 with opt-in CUDA and OpenCL backends for the hsolve compartmental solver, including a GPU Hines tree elimination for populations of dendritic trees, run-time selection of single or double precision, fixes to the CPU Hines solver, linear-time model construction, and a reproduction package that regenerates every published number from raw data in the repository (reproduce/claims.csv; the CPU-only results run on any Linux machine or in the bundled container).
